title: PIF Tower in Riyadh damaged in Houthi missile strike
detail: PIF Tower, headquarters of the Public Investment Fund in King Abdullah Financial District, was damaged on Nov 19. Reuters, citing three sources, reported it was hit by an incoming Houthi missile, with windows blown out across several floors. The coalition said it dealt with a missile threat toward Riyadh and debris fell; Civil Defense reported no injuries. It was the second hit on the district in under two weeks, after the Nov 8 Aramco building attack.
